content: Today was a good day. I started off with a refreshing hike at Eno River State Park, which always puts me in a good mood. It's nice to get out in nature and clear my head before a busy day. Then, after a long day of classes and practice, I ended the night with some video games at my apartment to destress. It's always a great way to unwind and relax. Overall, I feel accomplished and ready to tackle whatever comes my way tomorrow. Time to get some rest and recharge for the week ahead.
